answer: Rewards climb a seasoning ladder: a fresh identity earns nothing until it posts valid work five straight epochs; each rung doubles payout but adds a live eight-hour audit, and skipping one drops it two rungs. Every submission carries a behavioral pigment, a fingerprint of work production; auditors holding the lantern compare new traces to stored clusters. A farm must keep every alias active and audit-surviving weekly, so three hundred fakes cost three hundred streaks of inspectable labor, and no alias hides in the open meadow of anonymous volume. Cost scales with presence, not registration.
